ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This dispute turns on the trace and the fare record, not on either party's characterisation of the driving.

Deviation (POL-RD-01). The GPS trace of TRP-09111 (EV-GPS-09111, weight 1.00) measures the completed trip at 16.2 km against the booked optimal of 12.0 km (EV-TRIP-09111), an excess of 4.2 km / 35.0%. Both establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km) are passed, so the deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The trace is unimpaired for POL-RD-07 purposes (205 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s), so no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises.

Materiality and conduct (POL-RD-06). The excess is below both materiality limbs (50% and 8.0 km), so no MATERIAL deviation is recorded. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 610: no repeat-deviation pattern, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral. Only the two counters POL-RD-06 names have been used; every other profile field on either party is context only (POL-GEN-01), and no finding rests on reputation.

Exculpation. Nothing reduces the excess. There is no traffic advisory covering the route and window - EV-ADVIS-09111-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) and can carry no fact - and the driver's "I followed the road available to me" names no advisory; under POL-RD-08 a bare assertion carries no weight. The chat log shows the rider asking to return to the booked route, not requesting any detour or stop, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable. No pin amendment was made (POL-RD-05), the trip is not pooled (POL-RD-12), and the fare is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance remedy. No exculpatory clause was invoked against an absent artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not fire.

Refund (POL-RD-02). charged_total = SGD 33.36. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 12.0 km + 0.28 x 24.0 min) x 1.20 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 ERP for the on-optimal-route gantry + 0.00 waiting - 1.00 promo = SGD 24.224. Refund = 33.36 - 24.224 = SGD 9.136, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 = SGD 9.15. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and well below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

ERP (POL-RD-09). The Pioneer Road inbound line (SGD 1.00) lies on the optimal route and is properly chargeable, and it stays in the recomputed fare. The Tuas South Avenue 8 loop line (SGD 2.00) is off the optimal route and, more than that, is a gantry the trace never comes near: the nearest fix is 1,646 m away, far outside the 250 m crossing test. It is comprehended within the POL-RD-02 refund and is NOT added on top of the SGD 9.15. Because it is a charge for a gantry the trace never passes, it is also recorded as a billing-integrity finding under POL-RD-09(4), which is the referral above; a referral does not displace the money. POL-RD-10(8) is expressly not triggered where the only unmatched line is one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), so the case is not escalated.

Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 9.15 to the rider. No driver compensation is due - the fare charged exactly the distance the trace recorded, so the POL-RD-04 compensation limb does not engage. Confidence 0.90, capped by the 1.00 weights of the trace and trip record that carry the deciding facts.
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity: the SGD 2.00 "Tuas South Avenue 8 loop" ERP line on TRP-09111 is charged for a gantry the GPS trace never passes (nearest fix 1,646 m, well outside the 250 m crossing test in POL-RD-09); the line is refunded within the SGD 9.15 and is referred for billing-integrity review.
